evidence.title: Expose your design system to LLMs ・ Hardik Pandya

name: Expose your design system to LLMs
summary: Article on restructuring a design system into spec files, tokens and audits so AI coding agents stop inventing values.
description: A written method for making an existing design system readable by LLM coding agents: structured spec files the model reads, a closed token layer it picks from, and an automated audit that catches drift. It explains why agents fabricate token names and lose context between sessions, shows a file hierarchy of 64 spec files across three tiers, and reports results from applying it to Atlassian's design system.
